backup_simulation.info: Simulates a nightly backup by writing a timestamped archive file. Demonstrates scheduled execution and file I/O.

log_cleanup.info: Removes log files older than the configured retention period. Keeps the logs directory clean automatically.

health_check.info: Performs an HTTP health check against the configured endpoint. Fails if the endpoint returns a non-2xx response or is unreachable.

sync_check.info: Simulates a data sync operation by generating a reconciliation report with record counts and discrepancy tracking.

report_generator.info: Generates a daily summary report with job counts, failure rate, active users, and average execution duration.

session_cleanup.info: Purges expired and stale user sessions every 2 hours to keep session storage lean.

cert_monitor.info: Checks SSL certificate expiry for all internal endpoints. Raises an alert if any cert is within 30 days of expiry.
